40:2: The sending down of the Book is from Allah, al-Aziz, al-Alim.
40:3: The Forgiver of sin, the Accepter of repentance, the Severe in punishment, the Possessor of bounty. There is no deity except Him. The return is to Him.
40:4: None dispute concerning the verses of Allah except those who disbelieve. So let not their moving about in the cities deceive you.
40:5: Before them the people of Noah and the factions after them denied; every nation resolved to seize their messenger and disputed by means of falsehood to refute the truth; then I seized them; how was My punishment?
40:6: Thus the word of your Rabb became justified against those who disbelieved; because they are the companions of the Fire.
40:7: Those who carry the Arsh and those around it glorify their Rabb with praise, believe in Him, and ask forgiveness for those who believe: 'Our Rabb, You have encompassed everything in mercy and knowledge. Forgive those who repent and follow Your way, and protect them from the punishment of Hell.'
40:8: Our Rabb, admit them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses, and their offspring into the Gardens of Adn which You promised them.
40:9: And protect them from the evils. Whomever You protect from the evils on that day, You have certainly had mercy on him. That is the great salvation itself.
40:10: Indeed, those who disbelieve will be called to: "Allah's hatred is greater than your hatred of yourselves, because when you were called to faith, you were disbelieving." they say.
40:11: They said: "Our Rabb, You caused us to die twice and brought us to life twice. We have recognized our sins. Is there now any way to an exit?"
40:12: That is because when Allah alone was called upon, you disbelieved, and when partners were associated with Him, you believed. The judgment belongs to Allah, the High, the Great.
40:13: He is the One who shows you His verses and sends down provision for you from the sky, but none takes admonition except the one who turns.
40:14: So pray to Allah, keeping religion purely for Him, even if the disbelievers dislike it.
40:15: The Raiser of ranks, the Possessor of the Arsh, He sends down the spirit from His command upon whomever He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting.
40:16: That day they will come forth; nothing of them will remain hidden from Allah. Whose is the dominion today? It belongs to Allah, the One, al-Qahhar.
40:17: Today every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. Today there is no injustice. Indeed, Allah is swift in reckoning.
40:18: Warn them of the approaching day when hearts are at the throats, choking back (grief). For the wrongdoers there is neither a friend nor an intercessor to be obeyed.
40:19: He knows the treachery of the eyes and what the breasts conceal.
40:20: Allah judges with truth; those whom they call upon besides Him cannot judge with anything; indeed, Allah is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.
40:21: Have they not traveled through the earth and observed how the end of those before them was? They were stronger than them in power and more in traces upon the earth. Then Allah seized them for their sins, and there was no protector for them against Allah.
40:22: That was because their messengers used to come to them with clear proofs, yet they disbelieved; so Allah seized them.
40:23: And certainly We sent Moses with Our verses and a clear authority to Pharaoh, Haman, and Qarun.
40:24: We sent him to Pharaoh, Haman, and Qarun, but they said: 'This is a magician, a liar.'
40:25: When he came to them with the truth from Us, they said: 'Kill the sons of those who believe with him, and leave their women alive.' And the plot of the disbelievers is only in error.
40:26: Pharaoh said: 'Leave me to kill Moses, and let him pray to his Rabb. Indeed, I fear that he will change your religion or cause corruption in the land.'
40:27: Moses said: 'Indeed, I seek refuge in my Rabb and your Rabb from every arrogant person who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.'
40:28: A believing man from the family of Pharaoh who was concealing his faith said: 'Will you kill a man because he says: "My Rabb is Allah"? Whereas he has come to you with clear proofs from your Rabb. If he is a liar, his lie is against him. But if he is truthful, some of what he promises you will befall you. Indeed, Allah does not guide the one who exceeds limits, a liar.'
40:29: 'O my people! Today dominion is yours, being dominant in the land. But who will help us if the punishment of Allah comes to us?' Pharaoh said: 'I only show you what I see, and I only guide you to the path of right conduct.'
40:30: And the one who believed said: 'O my people, indeed I fear for you the like of the day of the factions,'
40:31: 'Like the plight of the people of Noah, Ad, Thamud, and those after them; and Allah does not desire injustice for (His) servants.'
40:32: 'O my people, indeed I fear for you that day of calling out.'
40:33: 'That day you will turn your backs and flee; there will be no protector for you from Allah; and whomever Allah leaves to stray, there is no guide for him.'
40:34: 'And certainly Joseph had come to you before with clear proofs, yet you never ceased doubting what he brought to you. Until when he died, you said: "Allah will never send any prophet after him." Thus does Allah leave astray the one who exceeds limits, a doubter.'
40:35: They are those who dispute concerning the verses of Allah without an authority having come to them; this evokes great hatred in the sight of Allah and in the sight of those who believe. Thus does Allah seal the heart of every arrogant tyrant.
40:36: Pharaoh said: 'O Haman, build for me a high tower so that perhaps I may reach the ways,'
40:37: 'Reach the ways of the heavens so that I may look upon the deity of Moses, and indeed I think he is a liar.' Thus was his evil deed made pleasing to Pharaoh and he was averted from the path, and the plot of Pharaoh was only in ruin.
40:38: And the one who believed said: 'O my people, follow me, so that I may guide you to the right path.'
40:39: 'O my people, indeed this worldly life is only a temporary enjoyment, and indeed the Hereafter, that is the home of permanent stay.'
40:40: Whoever does an evil deed will only be recompensed with the like of it. And whoever does a righteous deed, whether male or female, while being a believer, those will enter Paradise, provided for therein without account.
40:41: 'O my people! What is the matter with me that I call you to salvation, while you call me to the Fire?'
40:42: 'You call me to disbelieve in Allah and to associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, while I call you to the Almighty, the Forgiving.'
40:43: No doubt that what you call me to has no call in the worldly life nor in the Hereafter, and indeed our return is to Allah, and indeed the extremists, they are the companions of the Fire.
40:44: Soon you will remember what I say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah; surely Allah is the Seer of [His] servants.
40:45: Allah protected him from the evils of the plots they set, and the evil of the punishment surrounded Pharaoh's family.
40:46: They are presented to the fire morning and evening. The day the Hour strikes: Admit Pharaoh's family into the severest punishment.
40:47: While they dispute in the Fire, the weak ones say to those who were arrogant: 'We had followed you; now will you avert a share of the Fire from us?'
40:48: Those who were arrogant said: 'Surely we are all in it. Surely Allah has judged between the servants.'
40:49: Those in the Fire said to the keepers of Hell: 'Pray to your Rabb that He might lighten the punishment from us for a day.'
40:50: They said: 'Did your messengers not come to you with clear proofs?' They said: 'Yes.' They said: 'Then you pray; and the prayer of the disbelievers is only in delusion.'
40:51: Surely We help Our messengers and those who believe in the life of the world and on the Day the witnesses stand.
40:52: That Day their excuses will not benefit the wrongdoers; the curse is for them, and the evil home is for them.
40:53: And certainly We gave Moses the guidance and made the Children of Israel inherit the Book.
40:54: As a guidance and a reminder for the possessors of intellect.
40:55: So be patient; surely the promise of Allah is true, and ask forgiveness for your sin, and glorify with the praise of your Rabb evening and morning.
40:56: Surely those who dispute concerning the verses of Allah without any proof having come to them, there is nothing in their breasts except an arrogance they will not attain.
40:57: Surely the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of human beings, but most of the people do not know.
40:58: And not equal are the blind and the seeing, and those who believe and do righteous deeds and the doer of evil; how little you reflect.
40:59: Surely the Hour is definitely coming, there is no doubt in it, but most of the people do not believe.
40:60: Your Rabb said: 'Pray to Me, I will answer you. Surely those who are arrogant toward My worship will enter Hell humiliated.'
40:61: Allah is the One Who made for you the night that you may rest in it, and the day giving light. Surely Allah is full of bounty upon people, but most of the people are not grateful.
40:62: This is Allah, your Rabb, the Creator of all things. There is no deity except Him. How then are you turned away?
40:63: Thus are turned away those who deny the verses of Allah.
40:64: Allah is the One Who made the earth a dwelling place for you and the sky a structure, and He formed you and made your forms good, and provided you with wholesome things. That Allah is your Rabb; how exalted is Allah, the Rabb of the worlds.
40:65: He is the Living, there is no deity except Him; so pray to Him, making religion purely for Him; praise belongs to Allah, the Rabb of the worlds.
40:66: Say: 'When clear proofs came to me from my Rabb, I was forbidden to worship those you invoke besides Allah, and I was commanded to submit to the Rabb of the worlds.'
40:67: He is the One Who created you from dust, then from a drop of fluid, then from a clinging clot; then He brings you out as a child, then that you may reach your maturity, then that you may become old. And among you is he who passes away before, and that you may reach an appointed term, and so that you may reason.
40:68: He is the One Who gives life and causes death; so whenever He decrees a matter, He only says to it, 'Be,' and it is.
40:69: Do you not look at those who dispute concerning the verses of Allah, how they are turned away?
40:70: Those who denied the Book and that with which We sent Our messengers; soon they will know.
40:71: When shackles and chains are on their necks, they are dragged,
40:72: In boiling water, then in the Fire they are burned.
40:73: Then it will be said to them: 'Where are those you used to associate as partners,'
40:74: 'Besides Allah?' They said: 'They have disappeared from us. No, we were not worshiping anything before.' Thus does Allah lead the disbelievers astray.
40:75: This is because you used to rejoice on the earth without right and because you used to be boastful.
40:76: Enter the gates of Hell, to abide therein eternally. How evil is the dwelling place of the arrogant.
40:77: So be patient. Surely the promise of Allah is true. Whether We show you a part of what We have promised them or We cause you to pass away, then to Us they will be returned.
40:78: And certainly We sent messengers before you; among them are some We have related to you, and among them are some We have not related to you. No messenger could bring a sign except by Allah's permission. When the command of Allah comes, it is judged with truth, and right there those who follow falsehood are in loss.
40:79: Allah is the One Who created the livestock for you, that you may ride some of them and from them you eat.
40:80: And for you in them are benefits, and that you may reach a need in your hearts by means of them, and upon them you are carried.
40:81: And He shows you His signs. Then which of the signs of Allah will you deny?
40:82: Have they not traveled in the earth so that they may see how the end of those before them was? They were more numerous than them, more severe in strength, and firmer in their traces on the earth.
40:83: When their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they exulted in the knowledge they had, and that which they used to mock surrounded them.
40:84: Then, when they saw Our severe punishment, they said: 'We believe in Allah, Him alone, and we deny that which we used to associate as partners with Him.'
40:85: But their faith did not benefit them when they saw Our punishment. This is the sunnah of Allah that has been established among His servants from before, and right then the disbelievers were in loss.
